description: This is a FastAPI route implementation for the '/leaderboard' endpoint, which retrieves the top players based on wins from a database and returns a structured leaderboard response.

classes.name: LeaderboardEntry
classes.description: Data model representing an individual leaderboard entry, including username, wins, losses, and draws.

classes.name: LeaderboardResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of leaderboard entries.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Database model representing leaderboard statistics for a user.

methods.name: get_leaderboard(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint handler that fetches top leaderboard entries ordered by wins and returns them as a response.
